capabilities: Render indented pseudocode as a centred, line-numbered block with coloured keywords and comments
Group related algorithms in one class block separated by dashes
Insert blocks and expand snippets for fast typing (algo, for, mk)
Copy block links and add ^id identifiers for linking and embedding
Customise keyword lists, snippet definitions, colours and styling
extras: Beta versions can be installed via BRAT. The README states the plugin has no network access, never reads the clipboard, and edits notes only to add a ^id line for block links.
intentEvidence: Write pseudocode as plain indented text in Obsidian and get a centred, line-numbered block
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display pseudocode without resorting to LaTeX packages or images of algorithms.

relations.evidence: five lists of keywords, close to what the LaTeX algorithmic packages use
Snippets expand a short trigger into a longer line with values to fill in, as in LaTeX Suite.

summary: Renders pseudocode written as plain indented text in code fences as a centred, line-numbered block with coloured keywords, indent guides and right-aligned comments.
